categories.name: Identical Consonant Merging (Bus Stop, Black Cat, Bad Dog)
categories.drill_sentence: He waited at the bus stop with a black cat and a bad dog until next time when we help people find this street.
categories.rule: Jab ek shabd usi sound par khatam ho jisse agla shabd shuru hota hai (S+S, K+K, D+D, T+T, P+P), toh beech mein pause na lein aur sound ko do baar alag-alag na bolein; ek hi continuous dhwani se agle shabd par blend karein.

BUS.note: S+S Rule (Bus Stop): 'Bus' aur 'Stop' dono mein 'S' hai[cite: 16]। 'बस... स्टॉप' alag-alag na bolein, ek lambi 'S' sound ke saath 'बस्टॉप' (/bʌstɒp/) blend karein[cite: 16]।

STOP.note: S+S Merging: 'Stop' ko 'इस्टॉप' ya 'स-स्टॉप' na kahein, 'bus' ke 'S' ke saath smooth jodein[cite: 16]।

BLACK.note: K+C Rule (Black Cat): 'Black' ka 'K' aur 'Cat' ka 'C' ek hi sound (/k/) hain[cite: 16]। 'ब्लैक... कैट' do baar 'K' na bole, ek hold ke saath 'ब्लै-कैट' (/blækæt/) bolein[cite: 16]।

CAT.note: K+C Merging: Jaw drop karke /æ/ sound bolein (कैट), 'ब्लैक' ke turant baad bina pause ke[cite: 16]।

BAD.note: D+D Rule (Bad Dog): 'Bad' ka 'D' aur 'Dog' ka 'D' milkar ek single sustained 'D' banega[cite: 16]। 'बैड... डॉग' ruk kar na kahein, 'बै-डॉग' (/bædɒɡ/) bolein[cite: 16]।

DOG.note: D+D Hold: Tongue tip ko upper palate par rakhein aur single release se 'डॉग' bolein[cite: 16]।

NEXT.note: T+T Rule (Next Time): 'Next' ka antim 'T' aur 'Time' ka initial 'T' merge honge[cite: 16]। 'नेक्स्ट... टाइम' ke bajay 'नेक्स-टाइम' (/nɛkstaɪm/) flow karein[cite: 16]।

TIME.note: T+T Release: 'Next' ke baad bina double gap ke directly release karein[cite: 16]।

HELP.note: P+P Rule (Help People): 'Help' aur 'People' dono 'P' se judte hain[cite: 16]। Honth band karke single explosive release se 'हेल-पीपल' (/hɛlpiːpəl/) bolein[cite: 16]।

PEOPLE.note: P+P Linking: First syllable 'PEE' ko smoothly connect karein[cite: 16]।

THIS.note: S+S Rule (This Street): 'This' ka 'S' aur 'Street' ka 'S' merge hokar continuous /s/ banega[cite: 16]। 'दिस... स्ट्रीट' na rokein, 'दि-स्ट्रीट' (/ðɪstriːt/) bolein[cite: 16]।

STREET.note: S+S Blending: 'Street' ko 'इस-ट्रीट' na bolein, 'this' ke 'S' se hi shuru karein[cite: 16]।

categories.name: W (/w/) vs V (/v/) Contrast
categories.drill_sentence: Victor signed the waiver for warm water near the west valley window while drinking wine from the vine.
categories.rule: Round your lips in an 'O' shape for W; touch upper teeth to lower lip for V.

WAIVER.note: Starts with round lips /w/ and middle has teeth-on-lip /v/ (वेवर)।

WATER.note: Lips must be rounded for /w/ (वॉटर), do not bite your lip like /v/।

WINDOW.note: Both start and end require rounded lips (विंडो)।

VEST.note: Upper teeth touch lower lip for /v/ (वेस्ट)।

VALLEY.note: Upper teeth touch lower lip for /v/ (वैली)।

VERY.note: Vibration with teeth on bottom lip (वेरी)।

WINE.note: Lips rounded for /w/ (वाइन - drink), do not bite lip।

VINE.note: Teeth on bottom lip for /v/ (वाइन - अंगूर की बेल)।

VET.note: Teeth on lower lip for /v/ (वेट - डॉक्टर)।

categories.name: Voiced S (/z/) & Plurals
categories.drill_sentence: These boys played games for several days because he has those keys and his eyes love busy music.
categories.rule: Letter 'S' vibrates as 'Z' (ज़) at the end of auxiliary verbs and after voiced sounds.

IS.note: Must end with buzzing 'ज़' (/z/), never soft 'इस'।

categories.name: Silent Consonants (L, B, P, K, D, G, H)
categories.drill_sentence: The calm plumber should walk calmly and talk about half of the salmon debt receipt on Wednesday with honest knowledge.

CALM.note: Letter 'L' is completely silent. Say 'काम', not 'कालम'।

RECEIPT.note: Letter 'P' is silent. Say 'रिसीट', never say 'रिसीप्ट'।

categories.name: SH (/ʃ/) & Soft ZH (/ʒ/)
categories.drill_sentence: It is a pleasure to watch the special action and measure the vision on the ship before making a decision.

categories.name: Short A (/æ/) vs Short E (/e/) & Magic-E
categories.drill_sentence: A tall man and ten men put a bad bat on the bed while one woman told all those women to see the mane.
categories.rule: /æ/ requires wide vertical mouth opening (jaw-drop); /e/ is half-open.

MAN.note: Wide mouth opening (मैन). Do not say 'मेन'।

MANE.note: Magic-E makes long A sound (मेन / meyn)।

categories.name: Hard J (/dʒ/) vs Buzzing Z (/z/) Contrast
categories.drill_sentence: The zealous boy was jealous when the zebra jumped inside the zoo for a new job.
categories.rule: J touches palate firmly (ज); Z has no tongue block, teeth close with buzzing air (ज़).

JOB.note: Tongue tap for hard 'ज' (जॉब), do not say 'ज़ॉब'।

ZERO.note: Continuous buzzing 'ज़' (ज़ीरो), do not say hard 'जीरो'।

categories.name: Voiceless TH (/θ/) vs Voiced TH (/ð/)
categories.drill_sentence: My mother thinks that this thin cloth is smoother than that one.
categories.rule: Tongue between front teeth; air blow without vocal vibration (/θ/), with vibration (/ð/).

THINK.note: Voiceless /θ/ (थ जैसी ध्वनि), do not say 'टिंक' (Tink)।

THIS.note: Voiced /ð/ (दिस), do not pronounce as hard Hindi 'दिस' (Dis)।

THAT.note: Voiced /ð/ (दैट), tongue between teeth, not hard 'डैट'।

MOTHER.note: Soft voiced TH (मदर), do not say 'मद्दर' या 'मोडर'।

categories.name: Soft C (/s/), Hard C (/k/), Soft G (/dʒ/), Hard G (/ɡ/)
categories.drill_sentence: The giant giraffe rode a cycle to the city gym in a circle.
categories.rule: C/G followed by E, I, Y becomes Soft (/s/, /dʒ/); followed by A, O, U becomes Hard (/k/, /ɡ/).

CITY.note: C before I is soft /s/ (सिटी), not 'किटी'।

CIRCLE.note: First C is /s/, second C before L is /k/ (सर्कल)।

CYCLE.note: First C before Y is /s/, second is /k/ (साइकिल)।

GIRAFFE.note: G before I is soft /dʒ/ (जिराफ़), 'गिराफ़' नहीं।

GYM.note: G before Y is soft /dʒ/ (जिम), 'गिम' नहीं।

GIANT.note: G before I is soft /dʒ/ (जायंट), 'गायंट' नहीं।

categories.name: High-Frequency Corporate & Interview Words
categories.drill_sentence: Our executive scheduled a comfortable development meeting on Wednesday to improve pronunciation and environment.
categories.rule: Strict syllable stress and elimination of regional accent distortion.

ENVIRONMENT.note: Say 'इन-वाइ-रन-मन्ट', do not drop the N ('इन्वारमेंट')।

SCHEDULED.note: British English mein 'शेड्यूल्ड' (/ˈʃɛd.juːld/) bolein, American 'स्केड्यूल्ड' (/ˈskɛdʒ.uːld/) nahi।

categories.name: Short /ɪ/ vs Long /iː/ Contrast
categories.drill_sentence: Please sit on this seat and watch the ship and the sheep.
categories.rule: Short /ɪ/ is quick and relaxed; Long /iː/ is stretched with lips smiling.

SIT.note: Short relaxed vowel (सिट), do not stretch into 'सीट'।

SEAT.note: Long smiling vowel (सीट), do not shorten into 'सिट'।

categories.name: Articles Pronunciation ('A' & 'THE' Rules)
categories.drill_sentence: The apple was eaten by a boy on the street near the end of a long day.
categories.rule: सिंगल 'A' को हमेशा श्वा स्वर 'अ' (/ə/) पढ़ें, 'ए' नहीं। 'THE' के आगे स्वर (vowel) ध्वनि हो तो 'दी' (/ðiː/) और व्यंजन (consonant) हो तो 'द' (/ðə/) पढ़ें।

A.note: जब 'A' वाक्य में अकेला आए, तो हल्का 'अ' (/ə/) बोलें (e.g. 'a boy')।

THE.note: Consonant से पहले 'द' (/ðə/) और Vowel से पहले 'दी' (/ðiː/) बोलें।

categories.name: Prepositions & Common Function Words (Were, Was, Of, To, On, And, From)
categories.drill_sentence: They were on the train with a bag of apples and walked from home to the station while it was raining.
categories.rule: छोटे शब्दों के उच्चारण में वाउल और अंतिम कॉन्सोनेंट को शुद्ध रखें।

WERE.note: होंठ गोल करके केवल 'वर' (/wɜːr/) बोलें, 'वेयर' (Where) नहीं।

WAS.note: अंत में 'स' नहीं, गले में कम्पन के साथ 'वॉज़' (/wɒz/) बोलें।

OF.note: अंत में 'फ़' (Off) नहीं, 'ऑव' (/ɒv/) बोला जाता है।

ON.note: इसे 'ओन' (Own) न बोलें। मुँह खोलकर 'ऑन' (/ɒn/) बोलें।

WITH.note: शुरुआत होंठ गोल करके करें (विद)। 'विट' (Wit) न बोलें।
